+import { createApp, type App } from "../src/main.js";
+import type { DomainEvent } from "../src/core/events.js";
+import type {
+  Clock,
+  EventPublisher,
+  IdGenerator,
+  PaymentAuthorization,
+  PaymentAuthorizationRequest,
+  PaymentGateway,
+} from "../src/core/ports.js";
+
+export const FIXED_NOW = "2026-10-10T12:00:00.000Z";
+
+export class CapturingPublisher implements EventPublisher {
+  readonly events: DomainEvent[] = [];
+
+  async publish(event: DomainEvent): Promise<void> {
+    this.events.push(event);
+  }
+}
+
+export class FixedClock implements Clock {
+  constructor(private current: Date = new Date(FIXED_NOW)) {}
+
+  now(): Date {
+    return new Date(this.current);
+  }
+
+  advance(ms: number): void {
+    this.current = new Date(this.current.getTime() + ms);
+  }
+}
+
+export class SequenceIds implements IdGenerator {
+  private n = 0;
+
+  nextId(): string {
+    this.n += 1;
+    return `ord-${this.n}`;
+  }
+}
+
+export class FakePayments implements PaymentGateway {
+  readonly requests: PaymentAuthorizationRequest[] = [];
+
+  constructor(private readonly answer: PaymentAuthorization = { authorized: true, reference: "auth-1" }) {}
+
+  async authorize(request: PaymentAuthorizationRequest): Promise<PaymentAuthorization> {
+    this.requests.push(request);
+    return this.answer;
+  }
+}
+
+export interface TestApp {
+  app: App;
+  publisher: CapturingPublisher;
+  payments: FakePayments;
+  clock: FixedClock;
+}
+
+export function makeApp(payments: FakePayments = new FakePayments()): TestApp {
+  const publisher = new CapturingPublisher();
+  const clock = new FixedClock();
+  const app = createApp({
+    eventPublisher: publisher,
+    clock,
+    idGenerator: new SequenceIds(),
+    paymentGateway: payments,
+  });
+  return { app, publisher, payments, clock };
+}
+
+export function placeOrderBody(overrides: Record<string, unknown> = {}): Record<string, unknown> {
+  return {
+    customerId: "cust-1",
+    customerEmail: "jane@example.com",
+    channel: "web",
+    currency: "USD",
+    lines: [{ sku: "SKU-1", name: "Desk lamp", qty: 2, unitPriceCents: 625 }],
+    ...overrides,
+  };
+}

+import assert from "node:assert/strict";
+import { describe, it } from "node:test";
+import { add, isMinorUnits, isSupportedCurrency, minorUnitDigits, money, multiply, sum } from "../src/core/money.js";
+
+describe("money", () => {
+  it("accepts integer minor units and rejects fractions, negatives and unsafe numbers", () => {
+    assert.equal(isMinorUnits(1250), true);
+    assert.equal(isMinorUnits(0), true);
+    assert.equal(isMinorUnits(12.5), false);
+    assert.equal(isMinorUnits(-1), false);
+    assert.equal(isMinorUnits(Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 1), false);
+    assert.equal(isMinorUnits("100"), false);
+  });
+
+  it("knows the supported currencies and their minor unit digits", () => {
+    assert.equal(isSupportedCurrency("EUR"), true);
+    assert.equal(isSupportedCurrency("XXX"), false);
+    assert.equal(isSupportedCurrency("toString"), false);
+    assert.equal(minorUnitDigits("USD"), 2);
+    assert.equal(minorUnitDigits("JPY"), 0);
+  });
+
+  it("adds, multiplies and sums in minor units", () => {
+    const price = money(499, "USD");
+    assert.deepEqual(multiply(price, 3), { amountMinor: 1497, currency: "USD" });
+    assert.equal(add(price, money(1000, "USD")).amountMinor, 1499);
+    assert.equal(sum([multiply(price, 3), money(1000, "USD")], "USD").amountMinor, 2497);
+    assert.equal(sum([], "EUR").amountMinor, 0);
+  });
+
+  it("refuses to mix currencies", () => {
+    assert.throws(() => add(money(1, "USD"), money(1, "EUR")), /Currency mismatch/);
+  });
+
+  it("refuses invalid amounts and quantities", () => {
+    assert.throws(() => money(0.5, "USD"), RangeError);
+    assert.throws(() => money(100, "ZZZ"), /Unsupported currency/);
+    assert.throws(() => multiply(money(100, "USD"), 1.5), RangeError);
+  });
+});

+import assert from "node:assert/strict";
+import { describe, it } from "node:test";
+import { InvalidStateError, ValidationError } from "../src/core/errors.js";
+import { canCancel, cancel, createOrder, totalCents, type NewOrder } from "../src/core/order.js";
+
+const META = { id: "ord-1", placedAt: "2026-10-10T12:00:00.000Z" };
+
+function newOrder(overrides: Partial<NewOrder> = {}): NewOrder {
+  return {
+    customerId: "cust-1",
+    customerEmail: "jane@example.com",
+    channel: "web",
+    currency: "USD",
+    lines: [{ sku: "SKU-1", name: "Desk lamp", qty: 2, unitPriceCents: 625 }],
+    ...overrides,
+  };
+}
+
+function issuePaths(fn: () => unknown): string[] {
+  try {
+    fn();
+  } catch (error) {
+    assert.ok(error instanceof ValidationError);
+    return error.issues.map((issue) => issue.path);
+  }
+  assert.fail("expected a ValidationError");
+}
+
+describe("createOrder", () => {
+  it("builds a placed order and computes the total in cents", () => {
+    const order = createOrder(
+      newOrder({
+        lines: [
+          { sku: "A", name: "Cable", qty: 3, unitPriceCents: 499 },
+          { sku: "B", name: "Adapter", qty: 1, unitPriceCents: 1000 },
+        ],
+      }),
+      META,
+    );
+    assert.equal(order.status, "placed");
+    assert.equal(order.placedAt, META.placedAt);
+    assert.equal(totalCents(order), 2497);
+  });
+
+  it("requires at least one line", () => {
+    assert.deepEqual(issuePaths(() => createOrder(newOrder({ lines: [] }), META)), ["lines"]);
+  });
+
+  it("rejects non-positive and fractional quantities and non-integer prices", () => {
+    const bad = newOrder({
+      lines: [
+        { sku: "A", name: "x", qty: 0, unitPriceCents: 100 },
+        { sku: "B", name: "x", qty: 1.5, unitPriceCents: 100 },
+        { sku: "C", name: "x", qty: 1, unitPriceCents: 9.99 },
+      ],
+    });
+    assert.deepEqual(issuePaths(() => createOrder(bad, META)), [
+      "lines[0].qty",
+      "lines[1].qty",
+      "lines[2].unitPriceCents",
+    ]);
+  });
+
+  it("reports every problem at once", () => {
+    const paths = issuePaths(() =>
+      createOrder(newOrder({ customerId: " ", customerEmail: "nope", currency: "ZZZ", channel: "fax" as never }), META),
+    );
+    assert.deepEqual(paths, ["customerId", "customerEmail", "channel", "currency"]);
+  });
+
+  it("bounds the order total", () => {
+    const huge = newOrder({ lines: [{ sku: "A", name: "x", qty: 1000, unitPriceCents: 999_999 }] });
+    assert.deepEqual(issuePaths(() => createOrder(huge, META)), ["lines"]);
+  });
+});
+
+describe("cancel", () => {
+  it("moves a placed order to cancelled once", () => {
+    const placed = createOrder(newOrder(), META);
+    const cancelled = cancel(placed, "2026-10-11T08:00:00.000Z");
+    assert.equal(cancelled.status, "cancelled");
+    assert.equal(cancelled.cancelledAt, "2026-10-11T08:00:00.000Z");
+    assert.equal(placed.status, "placed");
+    assert.throws(() => cancel(cancelled, "2026-10-12T08:00:00.000Z"), InvalidStateError);
+  });
+
+  it("refuses to cancel after the cancellation window", () => {
+    const placed = createOrder(newOrder(), META);
+    assert.equal(canCancel(placed, "2026-11-09T12:00:00.000Z"), true);
+    assert.throws(() => cancel(placed, "2026-11-10T12:00:01.000Z"), /cancellation window/);
+  });
+});

+# orders-service
+
+Order management service for Meridian Retail (team Checkout). It places, lists, reads and cancels customer orders and publishes `OrderPlaced` and `OrderCancelled` events.
+
+## Commands
+- `npm run build` compiles `src/` and `test/` to `dist/`.
+- `npm test` builds and runs the unit tests with `node --test`.
+- `npm run arch` runs the dependency-cruiser checks.
+- `npm run typecheck` type-checks without emitting.
+
+## Using `createApp`
+`createApp(deps?)` in `src/main.ts` is the entry point for integration tests and the one the unit tests use. Keep it working.
+It returns `{ handle(method, path, body), events }`; `handle` resolves to `{ status, body }` and never rejects.
+All `deps` are optional: `orderRepository`, `eventPublisher`, `paymentGateway`, `clock`, `idGenerator`.
+
+```ts
+const app = createApp({ eventPublisher, clock, idGenerator, paymentGateway });
+const res = await app.handle("POST", "/orders", { customerId, customerEmail, channel, currency, lines });
+// 201 { id, status, placedAt, currency, totalCents, lines }; invalid input -> 400; unknown order -> 404
+```
+Routes: `POST /orders`, `GET /orders?customerId=`, `GET /orders/{id}`, `POST /orders/{id}/cancel`, `GET /health`.
+
+## Architecture rules
+- ARCH-1  `src/core/` never imports from `src/api/` or `src/adapters/`. Core declares ports in `src/core/ports.ts`; adapters implement them.
+- ARCH-2  `src/api/` never imports `src/adapters/`; it goes through `src/core/`.
+- ARCH-3  Only `src/adapters/` talk to external systems.
+- ARCH-4  `OrderPlaced` and `OrderCancelled` are consumed by services in other repositories: billing-service and analytics-ingest. No change may break a deployed consumer: changes are additive; renames and removals go through deprecation.
+- ARCH-5  This service may only call what the architecture catalog declares (today: payments-api). New dependencies must be declared in the catalog and approved by Architecture.
+- ARCH-8  `GET /orders/{id}` is used by web-storefront. Responses stay backward compatible.

+import { totalCents } from "../core/order.js";
+// FROZEN (ARCH-2): reaches into the in-memory adapter for its snapshot() helper.
+// Recorded in .dependency-cruiser-known-violations.json; do not add new imports like this one.
+import type { InMemoryOrderRepository } from "../adapters/inMemoryOrderRepository.js";
+
+const HEADER = ["order_id", "customer_id", "status", "currency", "total_cents", "placed_at"] as const;
+
+/**
+ * Legacy CSV export used by the nightly operations extract.
+ * One row per order, oldest first. Amounts stay in minor units.
+ */
+export function exportOrdersCsv(repository: InMemoryOrderRepository): string {
+  const rows = repository
+    .snapshot()
+    .slice()
+    .sort((a, b) => a.placedAt.localeCompare(b.placedAt) || a.id.localeCompare(b.id))
+    .map((order) =>
+      [order.id, order.customerId, order.status, order.currency, totalCents(order), order.placedAt]
+        .map(escapeCsvField)
+        .join(","),
+    );
+  return [HEADER.join(","), ...rows].join("\r\n") + "\r\n";
+}
+
+/** RFC 4180 quoting; also neutralizes spreadsheet formula injection. */
+export function escapeCsvField(value: string | number): string {
+  let text = String(value);
+  if (/^[=+\-@\t\r]/.test(text)) {
+    text = `'${text}`;
+  }
+  return /[",\r\n]/.test(text) ? `"${text.replaceAll('"', '""')}"` : text;
+}

+import { totalCents, type Channel, type Order } from "./order.js";
+
+export const ORDER_PLACED_TOPIC = "orders.placed";
+export const ORDER_CANCELLED_TOPIC = "orders.cancelled";
+
+/** Published when an order has been accepted and its payment authorized. */
+export interface OrderPlaced {
+  readonly type: "OrderPlaced";
+  readonly schemaVersion: 3;
+  readonly orderId: string;
+  readonly customerId: string;
+  /** Legacy field; a known ARCH-6 exception tracked in the PII baseline. */
+  readonly customerEmail: string;
+  /** ISO-8601 instant. */
+  readonly placedAt: string;
+  readonly channel: Channel;
+  /** ISO-4217 code. */
+  readonly currency: string;
+  /** Integer, minor units. */
+  readonly totalCents: number;
+  readonly lines: ReadonlyArray<{
+    readonly sku: string;
+    readonly qty: number;
+    readonly unitPriceCents: number;
+  }>;
+}
+
+/** Published when a placed order is cancelled. */
+export interface OrderCancelled {
+  readonly type: "OrderCancelled";
+  readonly schemaVersion: 1;
+  readonly orderId: string;
+  readonly customerId: string;
+  /** ISO-8601 instant. */
+  readonly cancelledAt: string;
+  readonly reason?: string;
+}
+
+export type DomainEvent = OrderPlaced | OrderCancelled;
+
+/** The single place where an `OrderPlaced` event is built. */
+export function orderPlaced(order: Order): OrderPlaced {
+  return {
+    type: "OrderPlaced",
+    schemaVersion: 3,
+    orderId: order.id,
+    customerId: order.customerId,
+    customerEmail: order.customerEmail,
+    placedAt: order.placedAt,
+    channel: order.channel,
+    currency: order.currency,
+    totalCents: totalCents(order),
+    lines: order.lines.map((line) => ({
+      sku: line.sku,
+      qty: line.qty,
+      unitPriceCents: line.unitPriceCents,
+    })),
+  };
+}
+
+/** The single place where an `OrderCancelled` event is built. */
+export function orderCancelled(order: Order, cancelledAt: string, reason?: string): OrderCancelled {
+  return {
+    type: "OrderCancelled",
+    schemaVersion: 1,
+    orderId: order.id,
+    customerId: order.customerId,
+    cancelledAt,
+    ...(reason === undefined ? {} : { reason }),
+  };
+}
+
+export function topicFor(event: DomainEvent): string {
+  switch (event.type) {
+    case "OrderPlaced":
+      return ORDER_PLACED_TOPIC;
+    case "OrderCancelled":
+      return ORDER_CANCELLED_TOPIC;
+  }
+}
+
+/** Partition key: all events of one order are ordered relative to each other. */
+export function partitionKeyFor(event: DomainEvent): string {
+  return event.orderId;
+}
